overloads.semanticRole: The JSON TO SELECTION command copies the contents of an array of JSON objects jsonArray to the selection of records of aTable .

constraints: jsonArray must be a JSON array of objects, e.g. "[{\"attr1\":val1,...},...]"; each element maps to one record by array/selection order.
If an existing selection exists for aTable, elements are copied into those records in order; if the JSON array has more elements than the current selection has records, new records are created.
Every touched record (new or existing) is automatically saved.
WARNING: this command overwrites existing record data, so it must be used with caution.
A record locked by another process during execution is left unmodified and added to the LockedSet system set, which can be tested afterward.
Supports Object type fields: JSON data for those fields is converted automatically.
